children: The latest U.S. Drought Monitor map shows that dry conditions out west are getting slightly less dire, but new dryness is developing in the southern delta states. Drought conditions in western plains states including Nebraska and South Dakota have eased, going from "extreme" drought to "severe" drought. Meanwhile, in southern delta states including Mississippi, Arkansas, and Alabama, dry conditions are getting worse--with Arkansas in particular blanketed with drought conditions ranging from abnormal dryness and extreme drought. CBOT grain futures are mixed in afternoon trading. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
